# Three.js r180 (npm 0.180.0)

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz

These files are copied without modifications from the official npm package:

- `build/three.module.min.js`
- `build/three.core.min.js`
- `examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js` → `addons/controls/OrbitControls.js`
- `examples/jsm/environments/RoomEnvironment.js` → `addons/environments/RoomEnvironment.js`
- `examples/jsm/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js` → `addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js`

Keep the core and every addon on the same exact release. No CDN is used at runtime.
